budget_items.topic: Refunding and school bond sale bids
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bond counsel's adviser reported bids on two series totaling $5.61 million, with $4.55 million for the school project and the remainder refunding 2004 bonds.
budget_items.quote: on two series of bonds totaling $5.61 million. $4.55 million was for the school construction project and the

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The refunding is said to save the Town $161,000, with average annual debt service savings of about $20,000.
budget_items.quote: the town saved $161,000, which is about 10% of the paramount of the refunded bonds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total amount now financed on the school project is $33.7 million, against a project budget of about $67 million less the maximum MSBA grant.
budget_items.quote: the total amount now financed on the school project is $33.7 million, covering the project budget, approximately $67 million, less the maximum msba grant

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Long-run school project impact is stated as $1.60 per thousand of assessed valuation, about $410 a year on a $257,000 single family house, peaking at $2.71 per thousand in FY2019 (about $700 on an average home).
budget_items.quote: the impact of the school project should be $1.60 per thousand of assessed valuation based on fy2016 assessed valuation of $1.2 billion dollars.

budget_items.topic: Bond sale prices and refunded debt
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The motion approves sale of $2,395,000 Series A and $3,215,000 Series B bonds to Robert W. Baird and Co., Inc. at $2,524,693.19 and $3,260,926.98, and refunds $3,978,000 of 2004 loans.
budget_items.quote: to refund all of the town's $3,978,000 general obligation municipal purpose loan of 2004 loans

budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY2015 audit showed available reserves of $2,538,910 and general fund expenditures of $32,109,269.
budget_items.quote: the fy2015 audit showed available reserves at $2,538,910 and general fund expenditures at $32,109,269 (7.9 %).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual cost of Option 1 (comprehensive renovation/addition to the Primary School) is stated.
budget_items.quote: option 1 presents a comprehensive renovation/addition to the primary school for municipal use. the conceptual cost would be $8,340,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual cost of Option 1A (demolish Primary School and build new Town Office building) is stated.
budget_items.quote: option 1a would demolish the existing primary school and construct a new town office building. the conceptual cost would be $9,000,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual cost of Option 1B (renovate Primary School and Town Hall) is stated.
budget_items.quote: option 1b would be to renovate the existing primary school (12,300 sq. ft.) and town hall (6,500 sq. ft.) the conceptual cost for this is $7,100,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual cost of Option 2 (renovate Ritter Building, add addition, renovate Town Hall) is stated.
budget_items.quote: totaling 19,200 square feet in both buildings. the conceptual cost would be $7,475,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual cost of Option 3 (comprehensive renovation of existing Town Hall, which the minutes say does not meet Town needs) is stated.
budget_items.quote: option 3 which does not meet the needs of the town would be a comprehensive renovation of the existing town hall building (5,700 sq. ft.). the conceptual cost would be $2,770,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Conceptual cost of Option 4 (use TC Passios School, selectively renovating and demolishing parts) is stated.
budget_items.quote: this would provide 35,000 square feet which includes the gymnasium and cafeteria areas. the conceptual cost would be $4,775,000.
